title: The Analysis of Historical Maps as an Avenue to the Interpretation of Pre-Industrial Irrigation Practices in Egypt
version: The Nile: Natural and Cultural Landscape in Egypt, pp. 255–344. Publisher PDF at https://www.inlibra.com/document/download/pdf/uuid/486029aa-9cbf-38b8-83f4-dffa90a07aa9?page=1&toc=5723285.
lineage: Historical-map and archaeological analysis. Early hydraulic interpretations on the cited pages discuss Butzer and Schenkel. The separate Fifth Dynasty relief is cited to Willems (2012), pp. 1101–1107.

passages.note: Schenkel disputed that the Scorpion macehead depicts an irrigation canal. The authors cite a scene in Niuserre's separate Fifth Dynasty sun temple as showing a dyke around a flooded basin and distinguish early local basins from later extensive networks.
